youtube_description:
In this episode of Future CFO_DP, Dr. Debasis Pahi examines why productivity gains from AI are no longer enough. Drawing on Esker's 2026 Global Finance AI Trust Index, Gartner research, Deloitte Finance Trends 2027, and IBM's 2026 CFO Study, we explore how leading CFOs measure AI by its impact on cash flow, working capital, and decision quality. Business students learn the skills required for the AI-powered economy.
